name: Quest Backport
teaser: Rebuilding and porting select quests from the official EFT release for compatibility with SPT.
description:
Purpose

Overrides quests to match the latest version of EFT, on top of SPT.

EFT has drastically changed its quest structure, quest chains, and trader reputation system since SPT 4.1.x was branched. Because of that, this mod does not apply EFT’s current EXP/rouble/reputation reward balance it simply no longer fits SPT 4.1.x. Start conditions and quest-chain requirements are also mostly kept as-is from SPT.

What it does change are the kill conditions, map conditions, issued gear, turn-in items, and some rewards across approximately 272 quests including a few that need custom zones (e.g., Golden Swag, Pest Control, Spa Tour - Part 7).

You can check the per-trader quest changes in the README. Quests not yet covered will be added in future releases.

As a bonus, this mod can also remove the sales-volume requirement from trader loyalty level-ups, just like live EFT. See the Config flags tab for details.

Note: While developing this mod, I heard the news about SPT 5.0. Still, I stayed committed to finishing it for everyone playing on 4.1.x. This mod won’t be needed once 5.0 drops, but until then, think of it as an early sneak peek at the new quests on 4.1.x!

Requirements
  • [WTT-CommonLib] >=3.0.6 required
  • [WTT-ContentBackport] 2.0.1 required
Installation
  1. Download QuestBackport.zip for the version you want from Releases.
  2. Extract it and copy the SPT_Runtime and BepInEx folders into your SPT install root, overwriting when asked. The install root is the folder that contains SPT_Runtime (e.g. C:\SPT), not SPT_Runtime itself.
    • Resulting layout: SPT_Runtime/user/mods/QuestBackport/... and BepInEx/plugins/QuestBackport.Client/...
    • The BepInEx folder is the client plugin that handles the UI side of the config flags. Just install it alongside the rest — it doesn’t affect anything else.
    • If your server root is the SPT_Runtime folder (older SPT layout), copy just SPT_Runtime\user\mods\QuestBackport from the zip into your server’s user\mods\ instead.
  3. Restart the server.

Upgrading from SptQuestLive (v1.0.4 or earlier): this mod was previously named SptQuestLive. Delete the SPT_Runtime/user/mods/sptQuestLive and BepInEx/plugins/SptQuestLive.Client folders before installing, otherwise both versions will load at the same time. If you changed any config flags, set them again in the new QuestBackport folder.

Compatibility

Works with mods that read quest data dynamically, such as Dynamic Maps and MoreChecks.

With Quest Codex installed, you can check the updated Kappa quest (Collector) details, including where to find each item and its drop chances, on its Kappa Tracker page.

Localization

This mod ships with English (en), Korean (kr), and Russian (ru) locales. If your game language is anything else, the mod’s quest text falls back to English. Everything still works, just not in your language.

Want to see it in your language? Contributions are welcome! Copy db/locales/en.json, translate the values (keep the keys as-is), save it as db/locales/<your-lang>.json, and open a pull request. The locale code must match the ones SPT uses (e.g. fr, de, ch).

Scope

Lightkeeper, Ref, and BTR trader quests are left untouched. Ref’s quests are mostly tied to Arena and don’t need changes, and Lightkeeper’s quests are end-game content that will be reviewed separately later.

Config flags

Mod behavior can be adjusted in db/Config.json.

  • questContentEnabled (default true): toggles all of this mod’s quest/reward content as a whole quest overrides and removals, alternative conditions, trader assort unlocks/removals, bot/static loot additions, hideout fixes, locale changes, etc. Set to false to fall back to vanilla SPT behavior entirely.
  • disableSalesVolumeRequirement (default true, experimental): removes the sales-volume requirement from trader loyalty level-ups, so leveling up depends only on level and reputation. The sales-volume counter is also hidden from the trade UI. This works independently of questContentEnabled.
Bug Reports

Please report bugs on GitHub Issues with as much detail as possible (SPT version, other mods installed, server log).

Credits

Special thanks to the Korean SPT Community and the WTT Team for kindly answering my questions and providing great support!
